AC5: a test proves two requests differing only by a path parameter produce exactly ONE route_template label combination (not two), specifically for letflow_http_requests_total

result.summary: Full 10-AC gap-check performed against docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-194 acceptance criteria, cross-referencing the actual test files and shipped moduledocs (all read in full), not ELIXIR-DEV's step-02a claims alone. Full rationale: handoffs/WF02-REQ194-20260830/test-designer-gap-analysis.md. AC8's grep test correctly and deliberately excludes lib/letflow/scheduler/poller.ex per design section 5/6's explicit statement that family #1 (active_instances) is not telemetry-driven -- Poller calling Letflow.Metrics.Registry directly is the documented, intended architecture, not a gap.
